name: Silk Masjid
summary: A continuous architectural contour joins one slender minaret to a flowing dome and a warm doorway.
why: The dome and doorway share x=57. A taller minaret on x=35 balances their wider mass. One perimeter joins the minaret, dome, wall, and foundation; the warm doorway meets its ivory baseline exactly at y=74. Curves turn directly into the hall with no floating roof or hooked trim.
risk: The line style feels graceful rather than monumental. At 24px the doorway becomes a warm notch while the minaret and dome remain the main reading.
sub1: A mosque assembled as one form
sub2: The accent belongs to the building
reasonToChoose: You want a graceful mosque with restrained detail.
